controlled.feature_policy: Exact 66 TypeB names/order projected from A; preserve source values and NaNs; no added features.
controlled.sampling: All mature TRAIN event rows; no legacy negative subsampling in any controlled arm.
controlled.weights: Each included TRAIN device totals one base weight; positive class ratio recomputed from weighted TRAIN only.
controlled.small_A: Sample A positive/nonpositive TRAIN devices to match B TRAIN device counts; preserve each selected device history. Three seeds, no validation-informed sampling.
controlled.cv: Same B held-out devices and TRAIN periods in all arms. A-only models fit no B rows; B labels are used only for B-target OOF operating-point calibration. A+B fold fits all A and only non-held-out B.
controlled.operating_point: Max pooled B TRAIN OOF device F1 across fixed steps; then fewer FP, earlier step; threshold frozen before later VAL or TEST.
controlled.scoring: Primary B; also A and pooled counts at the same B-calibrated operating point. Report all seeds, no TEST winner selection.

source_label_policy: Keep each source observed_start/end and failure metadata unchanged. Unknown follow-up never becomes negative.
publication: New sessions, events, models, provenance and reports on GitHub; omit credentials, raw data and regenerable large caches; document exclusions.
